title: Claude Code in the cloud: a field guide to cloud sessions
summary: Cloud sessions run Claude Code on dedicated VMs with isolated repos, ports, and branches, enabling parallel task execution and long-running operations. Seven workflow patterns support parallel backlogs, fix validation, CI auto-repair, sandboxing untrusted code, and more. Available in Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans.

title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
summary: The Cyber Verification Program expands with three tiers—Defense Access, Red Team Access, and Specialized Access—consolidating Project Glasswing with the original CVP. It supports Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Mythos 5.1, and future models, with safeguards scaled by access tier. Glasswing partners found 129,000+ verified vulnerabilities in four months, thousands critical or high severity.

title: Getting started with Claude Code mods
summary: Claude Code mods are small JavaScript/TypeScript files extending Claude Code's capabilities without API knowledge—describe what you want in plain language and Claude builds it. Hot reload enables live testing without restart, and $.state persists data across reloads for stateful workflows.

title: Claude now works with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides
summary: Claude integrates with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides, extending AI capabilities into Google Workspace document workflows. Specific features and detailed availability information were unavailable at publication time.

title: Customize Claude Code with mods
summary: This companion post announces Claude Code mods functionality. See the getting-started guide for implementation details and capabilities.

title: How Comcast and Booz Allen use Claude Mythos to find exploit chains and secure their codebases
summary: A customer story on applying Claude Mythos to security work, including exploit-chain discovery and codebase hardening in large enterprises. Detailed implementation specifics were unavailable at publication time.
